tabs.label: Sign in or create an account

side.tagline: Articles, discussions and the people who make them.

link.title: Get a sign-in link
link.sub: We'll email you a link that signs you in. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
link.sentSub: If {{email}} has an account here, a sign-in link is on its way.

pin.title: One more step
pin.sub: This account is protected with a 4-digit login PIN.
pin.label: Login PIN

landing.title: Sign in with your link
landing.sub: Continue to sign in on this device.

complete.title: Signing you in…
complete.stuckSub: Your browser may be blocking the sign-in cookie. Try again, or sign in another way.

closed.title: Registration is closed
closed.body: New accounts are not being accepted right now.

invite.title: Registration is invite-only
invite.body: New accounts need an invite. If a member or admin sent you a code, enter it below.

reg.name: Name
reg.securitySub: Pick a password, then choose how you'll sign in.
reg.passkeySub: Next time, sign in with Face ID, Touch ID or a security key.
reg.verifySub: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it below to finish.
reg.agreeBoth: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
reg.agreeTerms: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.

done.title: You're in, {{name}}!
done.body: Your email {{email}} is verified and your account is ready.
done.passkeyAdded: Passkey added. Next time you can sign in with it.
done.passkeyLater: No passkey was added. You can add one later in your account settings.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sub: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link. It expires in 15 minutes.
forgot.sentSub: If {{email}} has an account here, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.linkInstead: email me a sign-in link instead

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.sub: At least 8 characters. You'll use it the next time you sign in.

err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.invalid: That email and password don't match.
err.linkInvalid: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
err.resetInvalid: This reset link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
err.passkeyFailed: That passkey couldn't be verified. Try again, or sign in another way.
err.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys need this site to be served over https.
err.providerFailed: Signing in with that provider didn't work. Please try again.
err.providerEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with your password, then connect the provider in your account settings.
err.providerUnavailable: That sign-in provider isn't set up here.
err.lastMethod: That's your only way to sign in. Add another one first.
err.inviteRequired: An invite code is required to register.
err.inviteInvalid: That invite code isn't valid or has run out.
err.emailTaken: That email already has an account.
err.codeWrong: That code isn't right or has expired.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.both: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
consent.terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.
consent.bodyBoth: This site has terms and a privacy policy you haven't accepted yet. Please read them and accept to keep using your account.
consent.bodyTerms: This site has terms you haven't accepted yet. Please read them and accept to keep using your account.
consent.bodyPrivacy: This site has a privacy policy you haven't seen yet. Please read it and accept to keep using your account.
